run_generate_fake_colorectal_images: run the script to generate fake ColorectalHistology TIFF images for testing
create_examples_dir: create the examples directory path for fake test data under tensorflow_datasets/testing/test_data/fake_examples

review_write_image: review the write_image function that saves numpy arrays as compressed TIFF images using PIL
